BESL LPM Capability. When this bit is set to: - 1: The ports described by this xHCI Supported Protocol Capability applies BESL timing to the BESL and BESLD fields of the PORTPMSC and PORTHLPMC registers. - 0: The ports described by this xHCI Supported Protocol Capability applies HIRD timing to the BESL and BESLD fields of the PORTPMSC and PORTHLPMC registers.
